episodes.synopsis: Takumi is an anime-obsessed recluse with a fetish for two dimensional girls. His dirty little cyber secrets land him in real-life trouble after a chatroom encounter with the mysterious General.
episodes.title: Boot Up

episodes.synopsis: Takumi fears he may be losing his mind after finding the pink-haired girl from the murder scene sitting next to him in class. To make matters even worse, someone keeps snooping around his house.
episodes.title: Ego

episodes.synopsis: A chilling flashback to a tragedy from his younger days sheds light on Takumi’s reclusive existence. Back in the present, he attends a concert given by a clairvoyant performer.
episodes.title: Contact

episodes.synopsis: Haunted by visions of young girls carrying swords, Takumi begins to search for a weapon of his own. His frantic quest is complicated by an unwanted visit from the police.
episodes.title: Commencing

episodes.synopsis: As the police continue to investigate him, Takumi learns the secrets of the Di-Sword from Ayase, and a cyber friend sends him a video that sheds light on the New Gen case.
episodes.title: Guidance

episodes.synopsis: Takumi grows dependent on Rimi’s calming presences as he struggles to discover the power of his own Di-Sword, and a cryptic phone call shakes the city to its core.
episodes.title: Embracement

episodes.synopsis: Takumi is rescued from a group of hired thugs by a classmate with telepathic abilities. After regaining consciousness, he learns the identity of the evil mastermind behind the earthquake.
episodes.title: Realization

episodes.synopsis: The Gigalomaniac Trio embarks on a daring mission to destroy Noah II, but their enemy remains a step ahead, ambushing the would-be heroes with their own worst nightmares.
episodes.title: Linkage

episodes.synopsis: Yua goes to the police with information concerning Takumi, who receives a disturbing call for help from his little sister. Meanwhile, another New Gen incident occurs!
episodes.title: Rejection

episodes.synopsis: Takumi realizes the horrific truth about his troubled existence, Yua confronts the delusion of her dead sister, and Rimi attempts to rescue Nanami.
episodes.title: Purification

episodes.synopsis: The General and Takumi meet face-to-face to discuss their shared existence. Later, after awakening his Di-Sword, Takumi goes underground for a showdown with an artificial gigalomaniac!
episodes.title: Independence

episodes.synopsis: Takumi finally realizes his ultimate destiny: to destroy Noah II. But first, he must conquer the illusion of fear and defeat the one man standing in his way.
episodes.title: Mission
